features.title: Magic of performance
features.text: Bards weave occult magic into music, poetry and wit. They lift allies, rattle enemies and have a skill or spell for almost any social problem.

features.title: Composition spells
features.text: Compositions such as a courageous anthem can be kept up every turn for very little cost, making the whole party hit harder or stand firmer.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2 → 2–3.5. Damage-focused occult spells improve personal offense; anthem-enabled ally damage belongs in support.
ratings.defense: 2 → 2.5. Eight HP and light armor offer more resilience than the frailest casters.
ratings.support: 5 → 5. Compositions plus occult buffs, debuffs and control make party enhancement a defining strength.
ratings.utility: 4 → 4. Charisma skills and occult spells cover social and investigative problems well.
ratings.difficulty: 3 → 3. Balance compositions, spell selection and actions; extending compositions can ease the loop.
